title: The Geometry of Simulated Perspectives: Dissociating Representation and Behaviour in a Multimodal Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.08262v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal language models can simulate different observers, yet it remains unclear how assigned perspectives reshape their internal representations and whether these changes govern their judgements. Here, we investigate the representational geometry of persona-conditioned visual interestingness in Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Across 100 images and 53 prompting conditions, we systematically vary persona content and the linguistic framing used to introduce it, while recording behavioural ratings and layer-wise hidden states. We observe a systematic reorganisation of representational geometry across processing depth: early layers primarily encode image identity, whereas persona-specific structures emerge in later layers. Strikingly, prompt framing reshapes internal representations more strongly than persona identity, whereas persona content has a greater impact on behavioural judgements. translated_title: 模拟视角的几何学：在多模态语言模型中分离表征与行为
translated_abstract: 多模态语言模型能够模拟不同的观察者，然而指派的视角如何重塑其内部表征、以及这些变化是否决定其判断，目前仍不清楚。本研究以 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 为对象，考察人格条件化的视觉趣味性所对应的表征几何。在100张图像和53种提示条件下，我们系统性地改变人格内容以及用于引入人格的语言表述方式，同时记录行为评分和逐层隐状态。我们观察到表征几何随处理深度发生系统性重组：早期层主要编码图像身份，而人格特异的结构则在较后的层中出现。引人注目的是，提示措辞对内部表征的塑造作用强于人格身份本身，而人格内容对行为判断的影响更大。这种分离进一步通过最小同一性（此处摘要原文截断）……
tldr: 该研究发现多模态语言模型中提示措辞对内部表征几何的影响大于人格身份本身，而人格内容则主要驱动行为判断，从而揭示了表征与行为在视角模拟中的解耦现象。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that in a multimodal language model, prompt framing reshapes internal representational geometry more strongly than persona identity, while persona content mainly drives behavioural judgements, dissociating representation from behaviour in simulated perspectives.
